paite: Huchiin, Kris toh kaihthoh khawma na omtak ngal uleh, tunglama Pathian taklama tu Kris omnaa thil omte tuh zong un,
english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

paite: Tung lama thil omte ah na lungsim uh nga un, leia thil omtea nga louin.
english: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

paite: Na sita ua, tuin na hinna uh Pathian ah Kris toh selin a om hi.
english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

paite: Kris i hinna uh a hongkilak chiangin nou leng amah kiangah thupiin na kilak sam ding uhi.
english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

paite: Huchiin, noumaua leilam thil deihna omte hihlum un, kingaihnate, nitnate, huknate, utna giloute, huaihamnate; huaihamna tuh milimbiakna ahi ngala.
english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;

paite: Huai thilte jiakin ahi, Pathian thangpaihna tuh thumanglou tate tunga a tun nak;
english: for which things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

paite: Nou leng tumalama huai thiltea na nuntak lai un, huaite ah na om jel uhi.
english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;

paite: Tun jaw, nou leng hiai tengteng, hehnate, thangpainate, huatnate, gensiatnate, na kam ua pau zahmohte koih mang un.
english: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

paite: Juau kihilh tuah kei un, mihing lui tuh a thilhih toh na suahkheta ua.
english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

paite: Mihing thakin na kivanta ngal ua; huai mihing thak tuh a siampa batpih banga theihnaa siamthakin a om lellel hi.
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

paite: Huai ah tuh Grik mi leh Juda mi leh Juda mi, zeksum leh sumlouh, melmak mite, Skithia mite, bawite, bawiloute leng a om theih kei; Kris tuh bangkim hijawin, bangkim ah a om behlap lai hi.
english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.

paite: Huchiin, Pathian mi tel, misiangthou leh deih takte bang in lainatna lungtang te, migitnate, kingaihniamna te, thunuailutnate, thuakzohnatein kivan un.
english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

paite: Kua peuhin kua tungah leng thubuai nei bang hile uchin, kithuakzou chiat in, kingaidam tuah unla, Toupan a honngaihdamtak bangin, kingaidam sam un.
english: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

paite: Huan, huai tengteng tungah leng itna kisilhthuah un; huaiin thil bangkim kituak takin a gakkhawm hi.
english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

paite: Huan, Kris khamuannain na lungtang uah vaihawm hen, huchibang hi dingin pumpi khata sap na hi him uhi; kipahna dan leng thei un.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.

paite: Kris thu tuh a hauhna tengtoh noumau ah omsak kiihkeih un, pilna chitenga kisinsak leh kihilh tuaha oma kipahna lungtang toh pathian kianga phatna la bang, Pathian la bang, khalam la bang saa omin.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

paite: Huan, na hih peuhmah uh, thugen ah hiam, thilhih ah hiam amah jiaka Pa Pathian kianga kipahthugen kawmin Toupa Jesu minin hih vek un.
english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

paite: Jite aw, Toupa ah a kilawm hun bang jelin na pasalte uh kiang ah kingainiam un.
english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

paite: Pasalte aw, na jite uh it unla, a lak uah hanhat kei un.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

paite: Naupangte aw, bangkim ah na nu u leh na pate uh thumang un, huai tuh Toupa pahtak lam ahi.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

paite: Pate aw, na tate uh hihnuak kei un, huchilou injaw a lunglel kha ding uh.
english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

paite: Sikhate aw, saa na heutute uh thu bangkim ah mang un, mihing hihkipakte lel banga mit nasem hi louin, lungtang sakhata Toupa kihta kawmin.
english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

paite: Na hih peuhmah uh, mihing ading banga hih louin, Toupa ading banga hihin, kilawp takin hih un;
english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,

paite: A itna, gouluah ding tuh, Toupa akipanin na mu ding uh chih theiin, Toupa Kris nasem na hi uhi.Thil dik lou hihpan a thil diklou hih man a mu nawn ding hi; mi khentuamna himhim a om ngal keia.
english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

paite: Thil dik lou hihpan a thil diklou hih man a mu nawn ding hi; mi khentuamna himhim a om ngal keia.
english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
